description: §38.10.3 — an `onclient:*` handler IMPORTED from another `.scrml` module, where the exporter declares it `export server function`, fires E-CHANNEL-006 in the importing file. The handler name is resolved to the exporter's declaration through the import graph. (Multi-file: `helpers.scrml` is an aux import fixture.)
rationale: §38.10.3: a function designated as the handler for an `onclient:*` attribute SHALL NOT be declared `server function`; the compiler SHALL emit E-CHANNEL-006 and reject the program.
